items.title: Charlie De Vore Interview, 1962-07-04
items.q: St. Cyril. Yeah, that's right, St. Cyril. I read an interview by him.

ctx.x: Well, I hate to put you on the spot and you don't have to answer it. Who would you rather listen to, Jim Robinson or Henri Dutre? Jim Robinson, without a doubt. And so there's something to be said for a guy who's a real talk musician like Jim.

Yes, right. I'm not putting Jim down a bit because he had... Jim, see, it's like I say, he's learned as much music as was necessary for the band. Maybe Jim could only learn so much music, you know. Henri, on the other hand, never had the punch that Jim had. But to me, the more I listened to it, Henri had a very nice style. I'm not so sure that he didn't play quite a bit better live than he did in the records. Because I've heard Armstrong and other guys have played in that band. How many are left alive? I guess…
I think one thing is that you listen to him on the Dodge records and you can hear a little better what his style was like. I think he was on a Genet Studio disadvantage.
